selection.criterion: Largest mean final validation accuracy over the same V10 panel. Fixed final prefix only. Baseline remains a candidate; no per-dataset configuration selection.
selection.test_policy: V10 test targets were already seen. Select on validation only, freeze before V11 test reruns; call results iterative development rather than independent blind tests.

plan.selection_criterion: Largest mean final validation accuracy over the same V10 panel. Fixed final prefix only. Baseline remains a candidate; no per-dataset configuration selection.
plan.test_policy: V10 test targets were already seen. Select on validation only, freeze before V11 test reruns; call results iterative development rather than independent blind tests.
plan.retention: Fixed first-acquisition heads; compare final average and forgetting with V10 baseline
plan.mainline: Same frozen backbone and 32 inverse coefficients. No future shared updates. Fixed ridge alpha .1 and same support IDs as V10.
plan.extra_target_policy: Existing official cache; score baseline and selected final state after configuration selection; excluded from selection panel
plan.additional_candidate_reason: The four update variants did not exceed V10 on the complete selection panel. Evaluate a global serving-time scale of the V10 learned coefficients, with source initial score unchanged and box constraints retained.
plan.propagation_candidate_policy: Keep the V10 raw stream coefficients; extend separate propagation scales equally for initial/reset/cumulative. Select globally by the same validation criterion; report changed initial scores to separate readout gains from accumulation.
